records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like formoterol, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. Animal studies and limited human studies do not suggest an increased chance of birth defects with the use of formoterol during pregnancy.
records.source_section: Does taking formoterol increase the chance of birth defects?
